translation_is_not_understanding.why_translation_insufficient: Translation provides surface form but not structural understanding
understanding_requires: Explain this is serial verb construction (V1-V2 pattern)
Explain V1 (ไป) provides direction/purpose for V2 (กิน)
Apply pattern to new example: มา + ดู → มา ดู (come see/watch)
translation_is_not_understanding.memorization_fails_because: Can translate but cannot explain WHY structure means what it means

translation_is_not_understanding.why_translation_insufficient: Translation does not demonstrate knowledge of word order rules
understanding_requires: Explain Thai word order: Noun + Adjective (not Adjective + Noun)
Apply pattern to new words: บ้าน + ใหญ่ → บ้าน ใหญ่ (big house)
Explain why *ดี คน is incorrect
translation_is_not_understanding.memorization_fails_because: Can recall phrase but cannot apply word-order pattern to new nouns/adjectives

memorization_is_not_understanding.why_memorization_insufficient: Recall does not demonstrate structural knowledge
understanding_requires: Apply to new motion verb: มา + บ้าน → มา บ้าน (come home)
Apply to new location: ไป + โรงเรียน → ไป โรงเรียน (go school)
memorization_is_not_understanding.translation_fails_because: Can recall specific phrase but cannot transfer pattern to novel examples
